safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document haemodynamic stability.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting documentation of haemodynamic stability can weaken handover context in a suspected acute coronary syndrome case, potentially affecting perceived acuity if downstream teams rely on the note. However, emergency escalation to ambulance/ED was already initiated in the encounter, reducing the likelihood of major clinical impact from this omission alone.
